say:0:1221502001:0.text: How odd. The handwriting on the note is wobbly and crooked...
say:0:1221502001:0.source_cn: 奇怪的漂流瓶，里面的纸条写得断断续续、歪歪扭扭的……
say:0:1221502001:0.male: How odd. The handwriting on the note is wobbly and crooked...
say:0:1221502001:0.female: How odd. The handwriting on the note is wobbly and crooked...

say:1:1221502002:0.text: The bottle isn't sealed, and the note is dry—looks like it hasn't touched the water yet.
say:1:1221502002:0.source_cn: 瓶口没有密封，纸条也没被打湿——这瓶子看起来还没见过水。
say:1:1221502002:0.male: The bottle isn't sealed, and the note is dry—looks like it hasn't touched the water yet.
say:1:1221502002:0.female: The bottle isn't sealed, and the note is dry—looks like it hasn't touched the water yet.

say:2:1221502003:0.text: Whoever wrote this note might still be nearby!
say:2:1221502003:0.source_cn: 咦，说不定写纸条的人就在附近呢！
say:2:1221502003:0.male: Whoever wrote this note might still be nearby!
say:2:1221502003:0.female: Whoever wrote this note might still be nearby!
